messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy eu1:service-inference@2026-02-17-rc3 -> running post-deploy smoke probes (synth-embed, kv-warmup, healthcheck).

maya: saw synth-embed p95 jump to ~780ms on eu1 canary, started alerting.

sam: hmm, metrics look noisy, linking grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc/smoke?panel=embed  — can someone share recent probe logs?

jin: seeing intermittent 429s from embed-proxy around 12:40 UTC, ~18 errors in last 2m on canary hosts.

priyanka: did a quick curl from one of the probe nodes — returns 200 but payloads sometimes empty/truncated:
```
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null 'https://eu1.api.redwood/v1/embed' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-length: 0
```

maya: deploy-bot reported kv-warmup completed, but kv-prefetch miss rate spiked during the warmup window. suspect parallelism config too low and some cache thrash.

ops-oncall: recommendation: partial pin for stability. Keep control-plane traffic normal, but pin eu1 routing to model-embed-v1.24 (previous stable) while we investigate. Don't do a global rollback yet. @maya @jin any objections?

sam: +1 for partial pin. Also agree to scale embed workers x2 in eu1 as a short-term mitigation while we confirm root cause.

deploy-bot: Executing pin: model routing pinned for eu1 -> model-embed-v1.24 (sticky) at 1749991165. Notifying rollout-service and updating routing table.

jin: running a focused smoke run now (30s burst, synth payloads). starting at 1749991180.

maya: after pin + worker scale, synth p95 is back to ~210ms, 429s dropped to 0 in the last minute :thumbsup:. kv-prefetch miss rate trending down.

priyanka: opening a follow-up ticket: PM-1234 "Canary embed probe transient degradation" — will add checklist items: verify kv-warmup parallelism, probe payload size limits, and curl payload integrity.

sam: I'll update release notes draft: "eu1 canary experienced transient embed probe degradation during canary warmup; we pinned routing in eu1 to model-embed-v1.24 and scaled workers while investigating. Fix planned; no customer impact observed."

ops-oncall: closing the immediate hold. We'll keep a 30m watch window and escalate to full rollback if errors recur. Thanks all.
